sql: SELECT (MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(T1.screentime, 3, 2) AS REAL)) - MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(T1.screentime, 3, 2) AS REAL))) * 100 / MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(T1.screentime, 3, 2) AS REAL)) FROM characters AS T1 INNER JOIN movie AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID WHERE T2.Title = 'Batman'
SELECT T1.Name FROM actor AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.ActorID = T2.ActorID INNER JOIN movie AS T3 ON T2.MovieID = T3.MovieID WHERE T3."Release Date" = '2015-10-26' AND T2.creditOrder = 1
